tldr: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh indicated that further interest rate hikes might be necessary due to sustained high inflation, impacting market sentiment.
Deadly floods in Nepal and Tibet have left nearly 3,000 people missing, prompting calls for international technical support.
A Russian drone strike on a weapons warehouse near Kyiv killed at least 37 people, leading to an investigation into weapons storage near residential areas.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower, as remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole symposium signaled that additional interest rate hikes might be necessary due to persistently high inflation, and reports indicated a slowdown in the U.S. labor market. (AP: https://apnews.com/article/inflation-warsh-federal-reserve-d138f675aaa88c91b9dad6fd5823959d, AP: https://apnews.com/article/inflation-economy-iran-trump-fed-warsh-31077ff3bc27f6639689cf099f4c1160, Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/article/fed-chairman-warsh-shows-courage-with-jackson-hole-speech-defying-political-pressure-says-harvards-rogoff-140951926, MarketWatch: https://www.marketwatch.com/story/where-are-all-the-new-jobs-hiring-slows-again-and-it-probably-wont-speed-up-soon-66920f1d?mod=mw_rss_topstories)

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose, influenced by comments from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium, who indicated that rate increases may be needed given the continued high inflation. (AP: https://apnews.com/article/inflation-warsh-federal-reserve-d138f675aaa88c91b9dad6fd5823959d, AP: https://apnews.com/article/inflation-economy-iran-trump-fed-warsh-31077ff3bc27f6639689cf099f4c1160, Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/article/fed-chairman-warsh-shows-courage-with-jackson-hole-speech-defying-political-pressure-says-harvards-rogoff-140951926)

vix.why: The provided articles do not support a specific reason for the slight decrease in the VIX.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate increased slightly this week, tracking the recent rise in the 10-year Treasury yield, which closed up by 0.05% on August 28, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: Debian has officially voted to allow the "responsible use of generative AI" within its ecosystem. (Hacker News: https://lwn.net/Articles/1091231/)

OpenAI announced it has cut off Cursor's access, following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX, further escalating the feud between OpenAI and Elon Musk. (Hacker News: https://openai.com/index/our-decision-on-cursor-following-its-acquisition-by-spacex/, Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/altman-musk-feud-escalates-openai-150510914.html)

Google is reportedly now automatically expanding its AI search summaries, pushing the traditional list of search links much further down the results page for some queries. (The Verge: https://www.theverge.com/tech/986364/google-search-ai-overviews-auto-expand)

world.summary: Devastating flash floods in Nepal and Tibet have left nearly 3,000 people missing, with Nepal requesting international technical support for rescue efforts, body identification, and DNA testing. (Guardian World: https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2026/aug/29/nepal-tibet-floods-latest-updates-death-toll-missing-search-and-rescue, Guardian World: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/29/nepal-tibet-chinese-rescue-team-finds-nothing-but-ruins-after-reaching-border-crossing-hit-by-deadly-flood, NPR: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/29/nx-s1-5948209/photos-see-the-aftermath-of-deadly-flash-floods-in-nepal)

At least 37 people were killed after a Russian drone struck a warehouse near Kyiv storing "explosive objects," prompting Ukrainian prosecutors to investigate why munitions were located so close to residential areas. (BBC World: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c86xwqez4npo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss, Guardian World: https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/aug/29/russian-strike-warehouse-near-kyiv-kills-at-least-37)

Israeli attacks across Gaza resulted in two deaths and hit a hospital supply warehouse, as the Gaza Health Ministry reported increasing casualties and victims trapped under rubble. (Al Jazeera: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/29/israeli-attacks-across-gaza-kill-two-people-hit-hospital-supply-warehouse?traffic_source=rss)

Former U.S. President Trump announced a "historic" deal for the U.S. to control 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's oil, an agreement that Venezuela's interim president stated would help revitalize her country's economy. (BBC World: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2zlwe7qj1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

us.summary: Canada has dropped lobster tariffs, a decision that safeguards the critical supply chain connecting Maine's lobster fishing industry with Canadian processors. (NPR National: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/29/nx-s1-5945744/canada-drops-lobster-tariffs-saving-maine-supply-chain)

Sae Joon Park, a Purple Heart veteran who had self-deported due to convictions from over 15 years ago linked to untreated PTSD, has received a pardon, with New York's governor citing his rehabilitation. (NPR National: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/28/nx-s1-5948185/south-korea-deported-veteran-sae-joon-park-pardon)

Amid rising threats and abuse directed at its players, one WNBA team is partnering with national security specialists to address safety concerns stemming from the league's growing popularity. (NPR National: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/29/nx-s1-5947897/wnba-national-security)

science.summary: Scientists collaborated with narwhals by attaching sensors to them to gather data on warming Arctic waters, contributing to the understanding of human-caused climate change and its impact on rising sea levels globally. (NPR Science: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/28/nx-s1-5945279/scientists-collaborated-with-narwhals-to-study-warming-waters-in-the-arctic)

U.S. health officials have approved a landmark pancreatic cancer drug that works by blocking a protein that fuels tumor growth, offering a new approach to treating this deadly disease and showing improved survival rates for many patients. (NPR Health: https://www.npr.org/2026/08/27/g-s1-140410/fda-approves-landmark-pancreatic-cancer-drug)
